name: Alila Seminyak
positioning: Beachfront resort with contemporary Balinese design at the quieter end of the Seminyak beach, steps from the Indian Ocean
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront base near Seminyak's beach clubs and sunsets
Families wanting a kids' club and a dedicated family pool
Guests interested in Balinese temple culture

facts.text: Alila Seminyak is a beachfront resort steps from the Indian Ocean.
The resort occupies the quieter end of a beach that stretches north from Kuta and Legian.
Seminyak offers beginner surfing, sunsets and beach clubs including Ku De Ta and Potato Head.
The resort is near the Pura Petitenget temple, where traditional dance rehearsals take place at the Bale Agung pavilion across the temple.
Rooms and suites combine contemporary Balinese design, and each has a private terrace or balcony.
The fitness centre has a gym and the Movement Studio, a dedicated space for yoga and mindful practice, with floor-to-ceiling windows.
Resort activities include morning yoga, sound bath meditation, mat Pilates, Balinese dance, creative workshops and face painting for younger guests.
Play Alila offers activities designed for younger guests.
The resort's green initiatives include property planning that works with the natural landscape, its own hydroponic garden and support for local schools.
Condé Nast Traveler describes the design as clean lines and minimalist furniture, with a rooftop bar.
Seasalt restaurant serves wild-caught and sustainably harvested seafood from local waters.
The Beach Bar has daybeds and lounge chairs, with Alila signature cocktails, thin-crust pizzas and Mediterranean bites.

highlights.text: The resort has five infinity pools integrated throughout the grounds, including the Main Pool attached to the Beach Bar, the Family Pool and the Serene Pool.
The Alila Penthouse has three king bedrooms, a separate living area, a private pool, a sun deck and multiple balconies.
The resort has its own Segara Temple, where guests can take part in a Melukat water blessing led by the temple priest, Bapak Mangku.
The Beach Suite, one of the hotel's largest, has two separate living areas, a dining area and a wraparound balcony with beach views.
Spa Alila offers therapeutic massages, including the signature Alila Seminyak Massage, and guests can customize their own wellness rituals.

considerations.text: Ngurah Rai International Airport is 12 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the busy Seminyak area draws tourist crowds.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
